profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at StrongMind
profile.summary: Full Stack Software Engineer with experience in designing, developing, and deploying scalable web applications and backend systems. Proficient in Java , Python , and modern JavaScript frameworks with experience in AWS cloud services.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Designed and implemented scalable E2E testing framework with Playwright and Cucumber; created a custom Claude skill to standardize test setup and automate dependency installation, accelerating adoption across multiple applications.
● Tech: Java (Spring), Typescript (React), Various AWS Services, Various AI Platforms

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Designed and implemented serverless APIs using AWS Lambda and CDK, supporting high-throughput, low-latency workflows.
● Partnered with product managers and upstream/downstream teams to define API contracts and rollout strategies.
● Reviewed designs and code for teammates, contributing to higher code quality and more reliable deployments.
● Mentored junior engineers by providing technical guidance and pair programming to facilitate their integration into the project.
● Played a leading role in the end-to-end development of a cross-state title transfer platform, integrating Angular front-ends with serverless microservices running on AWS and written with Python.
● Tech: Java (Spring), Typescript (Angular), Python, SQL, Various AWS Services

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Delivered a new product line that boosted company revenue by designing backend data
pipelines and building an interactive Google Maps interface in Vue.js.
● Reduced site load times by migrating static assets to AWS CloudFront and applying
compression strategies.
● Tech: Javascript (Vue.js), Java (Spring), HTML/CSS, MySQL

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Designed and launched a subscription model that increased recurring revenue.
● Built internal analytics tools to process millions of records, enabling better operational
insights.
● Tech: Javascript (React), Python (Django), HTML/CSS, Elasticsearch, PostgreSQL

positions.title: Counselor
positions.locationName: Tompkins County, New York, United States
positions.description: Aid and advise diverse groups of students ages 11-18 in competition math.

educations.schoolName: The University of Texas at Dallas

projects.title: Dating Site Web Page
projects.description: Simulated home page for a dating site. It incorporates modern and user-friendly designs composed of a sleek UI that reshapes itself according to the user’s needs. Implemented using Bootstrap, JavaScript, CSS, and HTML.

projects.title: Income Prediction Data Analysis
projects.description: Trained data based on numerous demographic variables, then used classification algorithms to analyze and predict a person’s income level. Implemented using R.
